arxiv-2111-11626.title: Hybrid mapping of the Black Hole Shadow in M87 Journal: ApJ Astronomical Image Processing System ( Greisen 2003 , AIPS ;)
arxiv-2111-11626.creator: Chris L. Carilli, Nithyanandan Thyagarajan
arxiv-2111-11626.description: Abstract We present a reanalysis of the EHT 228 GHz observations of M87. We apply traditional hybrid mapping techniques to the publicly available ‘network-calibrated’ data. We explore the impact on the final image of different starting models, including: a point source, a disk, an annulus, a Gaussian, and an asymmetric double Gaussian.

arxiv-2210-11048.title: The quadratic linking degree
arxiv-2210-11048.creator: Clémentine Lemarié -- Rieusset
arxiv-2210-11048.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Clémentine Lemarié -- Rieusset. By using motivic homotopy theory, we introduce a counterpart in algebraic geometry to oriented links and their linking numbers. After constructing the (ambient) quadratic linking degree — our analogue of the linking number which takes values in the Witt group of the ground field — and exploring some of its properties, we give a method to explicitly compute it.

arxiv-2309-14286.creator: Archisman Bhattacharjee, Pawan Bharadwaj
arxiv-2309-14286.description: Abstract Hyperspectral data acquired through remote sensing are invaluable for environmental and resource studies. While rich in spectral information, various complexities such as environmental conditions, material properties, and sensor characteristics can cause significant variability even among pixels belonging to the same material class. This variability poses nuisance for accurate land-cover classification and analysis.

arxiv-2311-04114.title: Dynamics and Scaling of Internally Cooled Convection Journal: Communications in Nonlinear Science and Numerical Simulation
arxiv-2311-04114.creator: Lokahith Agasthya, Caroline Jane Muller
arxiv-2311-04114.description: Abstract Our goal is to investigate fundamental properties of the system of internally cooled convection. The system consists of an upward thermal flux at the lower boundary, a mean temperature lapse-rate and a constant cooling term in the bulk with the bulk cooling in thermal equilibrium with the input heat flux.

arxiv-2410-11136.description: Abstract A popular method for sampling from high-dimensional distributions is the Gibbs sampler , which iteratively resamples sites from the conditional distribution of the desired measure given the values of the other coordinates. pmc-13598389.creator: Ning Cui, Hongying Hao, Xiaofeng Hu, Yaxuan Li
pmc-13598389.description: Molecular residual disease (MRD) refers to occult cancer persisting below the detection limit of conventional imaging and is a major source of later relapse. pmc-13631983.title: C-reactive protein-triglyceride-glucose index and risk of incident depressive symptoms in older adults: an eight-year follow-up study from ELSA
pmc-13631983.creator: Mixue Guo, Mengyuan Cai, Huqiang Dong, Zongren Zhao, Ke Zheng
pmc-13631983.description: BackgroundDepression is a common mental health issue among older adults, yet few studies have explored whether metabolic biomarkers predicting its onset exist. The CRP-TyG index (CTI), combining C-reactive protein and the triglyceride-glucose index, may more effectively capture inflammatory-metabolic dysregulation than either marker alone. However, prospective evidence on the relationship between CTI and depression in aging populations is limited.
